card.name: Words leading into a decade or era
card.fires_on: Small linking words just before a time span in historical prose, such as "in the" before a decade like 1690s or 1790s. Also digits inside year numbers.

modes.label: Before a decade
modes.description: The word "the" or "in" right before a decade such as the 1790s.
modes.example: in New York City in<< the>> 1790s." Beginning

modes.label: Later or ongoing time
modes.description: A linking word that points to a later period or a span running on, such as only later, for the rest of, until.

modes.label: Inside year numbers
modes.description: A digit within a year or century figure in a discussion of dates.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying decade or decades and away from ancient or medieval era words.
card.plain: It fires on little words in history text that come just before a stretch of years, like a decade.
evidence: New York City in<< the>> 1790s." Beginning
